_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan Pemain {player_id} ing game LinesOfAction.
Bidak sampeyan '{side}', bidak lawan '{other}'.
Format obah: `[b1b3]` (koordinat-asal koordinat-tujuan). Obah sing sah munggah, mudun, utawa diagonal sakjumlah bidak (warna apa wae) ing garis iku. Sampeyan bisa nglompati bidak dhewe, nanging ora bidak lawan; ndharat ing bidak lawan njupuk.  Menang yen kabeh bidak sampeyan 8-tetanggan sambung.

invalid_move.wrong_distance: Kudu pindhah jarak sing padha karo potongan ing baris.
invalid_move.destination_own: Tujuan sing diduduki dening potongan dhewe.
